# Uilora Stroke Fill

Original component: Uilora / Stroke Fill.
Source obtained through the normal signed-in Code → Show Full Component view:
https://www.uilora.com/get-started/web/components/animations-motion/text-animations/stroke-fill

Application use is governed by https://www.uilora.com/terms . This is not MIT code.
The terms permit modifying and incorporating components into applications, including credited open-source projects, and prohibit redistributing components as a standalone UI library/component pack or claiming original authorship.

Used within the original Luma website concept. Adaptations: Motion import alias; Tailwind utilities translated to scoped CSS; themed font, fill and stroke; container fits the website instead of full viewport; replay is controlled by the host application; reduced motion supplied by the application.

No paid source accessed. Uilora Modern Buttons was confirmed Pro-only and was not copied or imitated. Preserve this attribution when distributing this application.
